summary: Short Swann Road kerb below an apartment block 7 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Hedge and apartments right behind; detached homes 13-22 m opposite.

drivers.convention: Some kerb parking visible, no signs on this stretch.

sun_shade: Hedge and trees shade from the north; open to afternoon sun.
